legacyRule: Both active and enabled required for learner visibility; an omitted update field retains current value; create defaults to true.
vnextRule: Current learner content reads filter status === PUBLISHED and learning path publication. Legacy flags are not stored in lesson_contents current Drizzle schema.

table.comment: Legacy active+enabled rule did not include vNext publish lifecycle. Retaining vNext DRAFT protections requires explicit policy; do not expose drafts to achieve naive legacy equivalence.
vNext archive controls retained; legacy flags alone do not map cleanly to this lifecycle.

securityDecision: Do not remove PUBLISHED requirement: adopt intersection of explicit learner access, PUBLISHED lifecycle and independently authored active/enabled flags after product/API review. Deny rather than expose otherwise.
acceptance: Learner PUBLISHED both=true accepted after tenant/delivery ACL
Unauthorized learner cannot enumerate shared or class content in wrong offering
Publication and archive transitions maintain intended vNext lifecycle
